title: Austin's Big Hire: City Manager Search
summary:
*   The singular purpose of the meeting was to select and appoint a new City Manager for Austin.
*   Designated a "Special Meeting," it highlighted the urgency and critical nature of choosing the city's top administrator.
*   The agenda was exceptionally focused, with no other public hearings or policy decisions scheduled beyond the City Manager selection.
transcript:
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: Notice is hereby given that a
Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Austin will be held on the 26th day of
July, 1967, at the Municipal Building, Eighth and Colorado, in Austin, Texas, at 10:00
A.M. for the purpose of selecting a City Manager.
S/ Elsie Woosley
City Clerk
S/ Harry Akin
Mayor
